details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The summary maintains clear organization by first presenting overall performance, then breaking down by segment, followed by cost management, cash flow, investments, and post-year-end developments. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between metrics (revenue, profit, margins) are consistent. The mention of one-off items in 2024 (S16) appropriately contextualizes year-over-year comparisons without creating contradictions. Segment figures are presented without implying they should arithmetically sum to consolidated totals, avoiding false contradiction claims. The summary forms a logical narrative from overall performance to specific drivers and strategic actions.
